## Scope

Every page after each section header, up to the next header, skipping divider pages (a blank or "---" name); the E-commerce section must end on Gift Cards. If the rule and the file ever disagree, **the build throws and names the pages; it never guesses**.

- **Marketing UI Components** — header [40935:41137](https://www.figma.com/design/yGEQmCZOvs7KptsYUdB0Xg/?node-id=40935-41137)
- **E-commerce UI Components** — header [43164:51148](https://www.figma.com/design/yGEQmCZOvs7KptsYUdB0Xg/?node-id=43164-51148), ends on Gift Cards (43164:52345)

Shape: every page in scope must hold exactly one component set with Type × Breakpoint × Direction; helper sets (no Type, no Breakpoint) are recorded as parts; any other set stops the build unless it is listed in EXTRA_SETS.
